title: 6 Hour Exotic Car Tour driving 6 Super cars + Lunch
blurb:
Drive 6 of the World’s finest and sought-after Super cars in one day while exploring Halton’s exciting winding roads and changing elevations. GTA Exotics is the original 100% Canadian and family operated exotic car tour company and we do it best! With 20 years of industry experience, we remain the leader of the pack running exotic car tours with amazing success!

Start and end your Tour at the beautiful Ivy Lane Estate (55 min. drive from Toronto or 45 min. from Niagara Falls)

Automatic transmission Super cars include: Lamborghini Huracan Evo, Ferrari 488 GTB, McLaren 600LT or 720S, Aston Martin Vantage, Audi R8 V10, Porsche GT3 RS, Nissan GTR, Mercedes AMG GTR, Corvette C8 Z51, Lotus Emira.

2 (two) participants per car will share the drive time & rotate through the cars together. You may choose to be a passenger and not drive in which case the driver next to you will take your drive time. Drivers must be 19 + & have Canadian G2, G or any foreign country driver's license.
